stateKeys.name: reworkCount
stateKeys.type: integer 0..2 — correction bends taken since the last fresh start (validation OR review failures share one budget; RESUME resets)

stateKeys.name: lastSignal
stateKeys.type: string, the concrete signal that caused the current position: '' | 'missing-deliverable' | 'verifier-failed' | 'defect' | 'spec-mismatch' | 'budget-exhausted' | 'escalated'

dataFields.gate: string - the DoRC gate verdict ('pass' | 'fail'); the GLM verifier's answer, never a human opinion

dataFields.reason: string - the concrete failure ('missing-deliverable' | 'verifier-failed'); handed to the rework as-is — 'fix this specific thing', never 'redo the job'

dataFields.finding: string - what the review found ('defect' | 'spec-mismatch'); named so the correction targets one thing, never 'redo the job'

specialRules.name: ready-requires-gate-pass
specialRules.note: Entering ready is mechanical: MARK_READY carries the DoRC gate verdict, and only 'pass' is accepted. A failing gate is an observable rejection — the card stays in backlog, and no human can drag it past the gate.

specialRules.name: work-starts-with-a-plan
specialRules.note: START_WORK applies only in ready, and it enters PLANNING, not implementing. The plan is the front-loaded context for the work: what gets built and how it will be proved. Implementation begins only when PLAN_READY says the plan exists.

specialRules.name: plan-ready-only-while-planning
specialRules.note: PLAN_READY applies only in planning; it is the single door from plan to work.

specialRules.name: verdict-only-while-validating
specialRules.note: A validation verdict (PASSED or FAILED) outside validating — a late or duplicate verifier event — is absorbed as an observable no-op.

specialRules.name: bounded-rework-escalates
specialRules.note: The only backward edges are validating -> implementing (VALIDATION_FAILED) and reviewing -> implementing (REVIEW_FAILED), each carrying its concrete signal and sharing ONE budget of 2. The third correction does not get another lap: the card moves to needsHuman with 'budget-exhausted'. No timer, no 'just in case' retry.

specialRules.name: review-verdict-only-while-reviewing
specialRules.note: A review verdict outside reviewing — a late or duplicate reviewer event — is absorbed as an observable no-op.

specialRules.name: escalate-only-while-active
specialRules.note: ESCALATE (a human pulls the cord) applies in ready, planning, implementing, validating or reviewing.

specialRules.name: resume-only-from-needs-human
specialRules.note: RESUME is the human's decision to send the card back to work: needsHuman -> PLANNING with a fresh budget. Re-planning is never automatic — the machine offers no path back to planning except this one, which a person takes deliberately.

specialRules.name: done-is-terminal
specialRules.note: done is a frozen terminal: re-opening finished work is creating a new card (fresh budget, fresh journal), not mutating a settled one.

noOpRule: An action that does not apply in the current state is reject(reason) — an observable no-op with post == pre, never a throw and never a silent return.
